images.title: Adding cement to change the ratio
images.purpose: Compares a 40 kg mixture of 30 kg sand and 10 kg cement (3 : 1) with the mixture after adding 2 kg of cement (30 : 12, which is 5 : 2).
images.composition: Two horizontal bars, one above the other, left aligned and drawn to one scale: before on top, after below. Plain white background, lots of empty space around the main object, no scenery, no people, no extra text.
images.exact_structure: Top bar: 40 units long, split into 4 equal blocks of 10; the first 3 blocks are amber (#E69F00) sand with the label 'sand 30 kg' over them, the last block is teal (#0072B2) cement with the label 'cement 10 kg' over it; label '3 : 1' to the right of the bar. Bottom bar: 42 units long; the same 30 units of amber sand, then 10 units of teal cement, then a 2 unit reddish purple (#CC79A7) block labelled '+ 2 kg'; a bracket under the last 12 units labelled 'cement 12 kg'; label '5 : 2' to the right of the bar. Exactly 2 bars.
rejection: any count of objects, cells, ticks or rows that differs from the numbers stated in the spec

images.takeaway: Keep the sand fixed and add just enough cement to reach the new ratio.
images.description: Compares a 40 kg mixture of 30 kg sand and 10 kg cement (3 : 1) with the mixture after adding 2 kg of cement (30 : 12, which is 5 : 2).

image_decisions.why: A before and after bar shows which part stays fixed and how much is added.
